purpose: Which warehouse measurement concepts govern the control of a library condition. A control or trend question about a condition ('is the diabetes control getting better') is answered from these measures. Keys are clinical_core/agere/clinical/concepts.CONDITIONS; measures are concepts.MEASUREMENTS keys (a measure the warehouse does not have is skipped at load, never invented).

diabetes.source: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, Glycemic Goals (HbA1c is the glycemic control measure); NCQA HEDIS Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes

type_2_diabetes.source: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, Glycemic Goals; NCQA HEDIS Glycemic Status Assessment

type_1_diabetes.source: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, Glycemic Goals; NCQA HEDIS Glycemic Status Assessment

prediabetes.source: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes, Diagnosis and Classification (HbA1c 5.7 to 6.4 percent)

hypertension.source: 2017 ACC/AHA High Blood Pressure Guideline; NCQA HEDIS Controlling High Blood Pressure (systolic and diastolic)

chronic_kidney_disease.source: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for CKD (GFR and albuminuria categories define stage and progression)

heart_failure.source: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline (natriuretic peptide for monitoring and prognosis); LVEF is an imaging result, not a measurement in this warehouse

heart_failure_reduced_ef.source: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline (natriuretic peptide); LVEF is an imaging result, not a measurement in this warehouse

hyperlipidemia.source: 2018 AHA/ACC Cholesterol Guideline (LDL-C response to therapy); NCQA HEDIS statin measures

coronary_artery_disease.source: 2018 AHA/ACC Cholesterol Guideline (LDL-C for secondary prevention)

depression.source: Kroenke 2001 PHQ-9 validation; NCQA HEDIS Depression Remission or Response (PHQ-9 follow-up)

hypothyroidism.source: ATA 2014 Guidelines for the Treatment of Hypothyroidism (TSH is the monitoring measure)

anemia.source: WHO 2011 hemoglobin concentrations for the diagnosis of anaemia

obesity.source: 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS Guideline for the Management of Overweight and Obesity in Adults (weight change)
